## Checklist

- [ ] Each commit has a truthful DCO `Signed-off-by` line.
- [ ] Source, tests, and documentation agree; no capability is fabricated.
- [ ] No binaries, large logs, private paths, credentials, or production files are included.
- [ ] Third-party notices remain intact and new dependencies have license/provenance review.
- [ ] LoongArch flags remain scoped to loongarch64; other architectures are considered.
- [ ] Hardware tests remain opt-in and use an explicit staged ICD manifest.
- [ ] Negative cases, cleanup, and rollback/security impact were considered.
- [ ] CHANGELOG/ROADMAP/HARDWARE/TESTING were updated where applicable.
